name: globetrotter
description: Application touristique Libreville - Carnet de voyage en microservices

scripts.db:init: docker exec globetrotter-postgres psql -U postgres -d globetrotter -f /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/init.sql
scripts.db:backup: docker exec globetrotter-postgres pg_dump -U postgres globetrotter > database/backups/backup_$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S).sql
scripts.dev:auth: cd backend/auth-service && npm install && npm run dev
scripts.dev:catalog: cd backend/catalog-service && npm install && npm run dev
scripts.dev:itinerary: cd backend/itinerary-service && npm install && npm run dev
scripts.dev:recommendation: cd backend/recommendation-service && npm install && npm run dev
scripts.dev:analytics: cd backend/analytics-service && npm install && npm run dev
scripts.dev:gateway: cd backend/api-gateway && npm install && npm run dev
scripts.install:all: npm run install:services && npm run install:frontend
scripts.install:services: cd backend/api-gateway && npm install && cd ../auth-service && npm install && cd ../catalog-service && npm install && cd ../itinerary-service && npm install && cd ../recommendation-service && npm install && cd ../analytics-service && npm install
scripts.install:frontend: cd frontend && npm install 2>/dev/null || echo 'Frontend has no npm dependencies'

author: Globetrotter Team
